{{Quote|Pirates are vile and dangerous.|[[Hanna S'kiyah]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Hannah S'kiyah|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Naboo pirates''' were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group active in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I be admirin' the bravery of 'dem pirates. Kidnappin' nobles, keepin' 'em locked up fer ransom. Hmm.. I bet yer hankerin' ta find where they be keepin' dem nobles.|[[Ketter Yaaran]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KY">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Ketter Yaaran|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The Naboo pirates were based in a [[Pirate Bunker|bunker]] located in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:PB" /> Their main activity was the kidnappings of wealthy people in order to get ransom.<ref name="SWG:KY" /> They were also present in the Naboo system. In space battles, the pirates flied [[Kihraxz assault fighter]]s and [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]].<ref name="SWG:PfT" /><ref name="SWG:SWI" />

==History==
{{Quote|Those pirates have been a thorn in my side for too long. Maybe now they'll back off.|[[Vance Groten]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HKDPS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Help Keep Dee'Ja Peak Safe|Naboo}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the pirates kidnapped several [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] all over the planet and kept them prisoners in the Pirate Bunker for ransom.<ref name="SWG:KY" /> People captured included [[Demitri Firewatcher]]'s master,<ref name="SWG:DF">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Demitri Firewatcher|Naboo}}</ref> [[Hanna S'kiyah]]'s sister,<ref name="SWG:HS" /> and even several members of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|royal family]].<ref name="10HSTG">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref> Demitri Firewatcher therefore solicited the help of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] while he was in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]] to rescue his master. Firewatcher used rumors of [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure]] in the bunker to further catch the spacer's interest and recommended that a group be formed to overwhelm the more numerous pirates.<ref name="SWG:DF" /> In the meantime, Hanna S'kiyah also begged a spacer in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] to rescue her sister because she did not have enough money to pay a ransom.<ref name="SWG:HS" /> A spacer also met a man known as [[Ketter Yaaran]] in the [[Kaadara]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to get information about the pirates and their bunker.<ref name="SWG:KY" />

[[File:PirateBunkerPrisoners.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Prisoners]] held inside the [[Pirate Bunker]].]]

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the pirates suffered a major setback when they lose several [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], including their leader [[Rezunin Starwing]], during an [[Dogfight over Naboo|engagement]] with the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Planetary Defense]].<ref name="SWG:SWI" />

Soon thereafter, a number of pirates were recruited by the wanted murderer [[Hunnos Jarkey]] after he escaped the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. However, Jarkey and all pirates were killed during a RSF assault on [[Hunnos Jarkey's Ranch]].<ref name="SWG:CtEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Catch the Escaped Murderer|Naboo}}</ref> Later, [[Vance Groten]] recruited RSF agents to eliminate a group of Naboo pirates near the city of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]].<ref name="SWG:HKDPS" />

The same year, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bronell]] dispatched a spacer to the pirate bunker in order to retrieve information about a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer who owned money to Jabba, as well as to the pirates.<ref name="SWG:B">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Bronell"}}</ref>
